description: `AwsCrtAsyncHttpClient` now applies `connectionAcquisitionTimeout` to HTTP/2 requests waiting for a stream when all `maxConcurrency` streams are in use, or for a new connection, matching the Netty client. Previously these requests waited without a time limit. They now fail after the acquisition timeout (10 seconds by default) and are not retried. To allow longer waits, increase `maxConcurrency` or `connectionAcquisitionTimeout`.
